keep_playing_why: B made me think. The block had to be pulled, not pushed. Mirrors have a dead zone, and I had to sweep mirror 1 the long way round to reach mirror 2. A stele only woke when its lens was hit face-on, so I had to relay the light from the south. By minute nine I was playing very differently than in minute one. A was the same loop at minute nine as at minute one: stand in colour, auto-aim, bloom when full.
better_made_why: A loads fast, is readable almost instantly, and has strong juice: the ink-to-colour bloom, chain multipliers and a clear hurt sound. It still has a murky damage source, a drifting camera and a few black screens from clipping into trees. B looks lovely and teaches with clear prompts, but has a 15 s load, camera clipping through the gate and walls, a block pull that can walk you off the court into a stuck pit, and a flaky first grab press.
furthest_A: Broke all three nodes and restored the first inkwell (Olive Terraces, 'restored' banner at about 376 s, Split Lens perk, 4 inkwells left); reached about 13 m from the second inkwell at about 510 s but died before breaking it; score about 102,600 at x4 peak, 5.1% restored.
furthest_B: Level 1 The Sunken Court: cleared the block from the sunbeam, lit stele 1 of 3 (infinity glyph) with mirror 1, then relayed mirror 1 to mirror 2 and lit stele 2 (triangle glyph), 'Stelae lit: 2 of 3' at about 458 s. The third stele (spiral, via the island mirror) and the gate were not reached. I also restarted once at about 225 s after getting wedged.
